entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium transparent 2D game VFX sprite, square 1024x1024. ONE perfectly centered circular blue magic seal, straight-on orthographic view. A precise SIX-POINTED HEXAGRAM made of TWO interlocking equilateral triangles, bright icy cyan fine etched lines, clearly six tips. Two concentric circular borders, refined engraved arc segments and small abstract mystical marks on the outer band, symmetric elegant fine filigree, delicate cobalt inner line and a restrained cyan glow hugging lines. The center and gaps MUST be truly transparent so a character is readable in front. No opaque disk, no filled triangles, no text labels, no real alphabet words, no stars scattered beyond circle, no scene, no character, no perspective or ground. Fit entire seal within 88 percent of canvas with clear transparent margin. Thin but legible lines designed for display at 330px. High quality anime fantasy magical effect, not a rough diagram. True alpha transparency outside and between every line. A single complete isolated asset ready to rotate and scale in Unity.
